events.title: Circle of Lights
events.blurb: Indy's holiday kickoff on Monument Circle, with live music, vendors and activities from 5 p.m. The monument's lights are switched on just before 7 p.m.
events.blurbEs: El inicio de las fiestas en Indy en Monument Circle, con música en vivo, vendedores y actividades desde las 5 p.m. Las luces del monumento se encienden poco antes de las 7 p.m.

events.title: Pacers vs. Philadelphia 76ers
events.blurb: The Pacers host Philadelphia downtown on Black Friday night.
events.blurbEs: Los Pacers reciben a Philadelphia en el centro la noche del Black Friday.

events.title: Colts vs. New York Giants
events.blurb: Week 12 of the NFL season: the Colts host the Giants with a 1 p.m. kickoff on Sunday.
events.blurbEs: Semana 12 de la NFL: los Colts reciben a los Giants el domingo a la 1 p.m.

events.title: Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol
events.blurb: The IRT's annual holiday staging of the Dickens story on its OneAmerica Financial Stage. Assisted listening devices are available at every performance.
events.blurbEs: La producción navideña anual del IRT del cuento de Dickens en su OneAmerica Financial Stage. Hay dispositivos de asistencia auditiva en todas las funciones.

events.title: Tony Rock
events.blurb: Comedian and actor Tony Rock headlines five shows over the weekend in Helium's main showroom.
events.blurbEs: El comediante y actor Tony Rock encabeza cinco funciones durante el fin de semana en la sala principal de Helium.

events.title: Rival Sons
events.blurb: The California rock band plays Broad Ripple with The Blue Stones and The Velveteers. General admission; doors at 7 p.m.
events.blurbEs: La banda de rock californiana toca en Broad Ripple con The Blue Stones y The Velveteers. Admisión general; puertas a las 7 p.m.

events.title: Christmas at the Zoo
events.blurb: The zoo lights up for the holidays each evening from 5 p.m., with festivities included in regular admission.
events.blurbEs: El zoológico se ilumina para las fiestas cada noche desde las 5 p.m., con actividades incluidas en la entrada general.

events.title: Carmel Christkindlmarkt
events.blurb: A German-style outdoor holiday market in Carmel with food, drinks and gifts. Admission and parking are free; ice skating is ticketed.
events.blurbEs: Un mercado navideño al aire libre de estilo alemán en Carmel con comida, bebidas y regalos. La entrada y el estacionamiento son gratis; el patinaje sobre hielo requiere boleto.

events.title: Indy Fuel vs. Bloomington Bison
events.blurb: ECHL hockey: the Fuel host Bloomington with a 4 p.m. puck drop on Sunday.
events.blurbEs: Hockey de la ECHL: los Fuel reciben a Bloomington el domingo con inicio a las 4 p.m.
